event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!
event.disclaimer: Restaurants are solely responsible for the service; availability and quality of the events including all or any cancellations/ modifications/ complaints.

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!
event.disclaimer: Restaurants are solely responsible for the service; availability and quality of the events including all or any cancellations/ modifications/ complaints.

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.description:
Circlelost is a Pop/Rock trio based in Guwahati/Delhi with Amitabh Barooa on Vocals and Piano, Siddharth Barroa on Bass and Nishant Hagjer on Drums. They released their first song 'None to Wake Us' on 15th August 2016.  

Circlelost is the brainchild of Amitabh and Siddharth of the band Lucid Recess. This project essentially came into being to express a new side of them musically and to keep feeding their need to create more music. A few months after starting the work, Nishant Hagjer (Undying Inc., Underside and Rectified Spirit) joined them on the drums and they were ready.  

As musicians, the three are routinely involved in heavier forms of music, one more than the others. But their association as Circlelost is not just different but a very exciting change for all of them. What they are, at the core, is a simple pop/rock project with a tiny bit of soul/R&B. But with each song, what they incorporate within that is what makes it interesting.

event.title: Senor Elefante with Nathalie
event.description:
'Crooner' is an American epithet given to male singers of jazz standards, mostly from the Great American Songbook, either backed by a full orchestra, a big band or by a piano. Originally it was an ironic term denoting an emphatically sentimental, often emotional singing style made possible by the use of microphones. (ref. Wiki)  

The only difference here is that the crooner is from India. And he performs in and out of songbooks.  

Nikhil Mawkin, a.k.a Senor Elefante, explores vocal based repertoire majorly and performs music ranging from various genres and languages, mainly in an environment created by acoustic/semi-acoustic instruments though.

Senor Elefante performs in duo/trio/band settings, depending on a particular scenario.  

For the show, he is accompanied by Nathalie Ramirez on flute.

event.title: Abhind
event.description:
Abhind is a jazz trio founded by its bassist Pierre-Antoine Lasnier who creates original compositions to express his inner feelings and his journey through life from France to India. The band is composed of Shonai on the piano and Aniruddh Saha on the drums.  

Abhind's music is multiple and cannot be reduced to a single format or a particular shape  as it is the description of an around the world journey. It transcribes the multiplicity of life, emotions, people and places with a documentary shape through sounds.  

The first album of Abhind, "From Kolkata" represents the first part of the depiction of this journey. Even though Pierre-Antoine Lasnier is actually from Paris, France, the compositions where made in the capital of Bengal in India and find their roots in this city. They are the description of the first part of the journey and its conclusion.  

The compositions were made in 2016 while the album will be available at the end of 2017.

event.description:
Akash Vincent is a singer-songwriter living in New Delhi. He started his musical training on drums, which he played throughout high school and college. He first felt drawn to songwriting during sessions with his college band. In these practices he realized he had a strong imagination and clear vision for how he wanted to craft the songs and decided to write songs under his own name. 

He recorded his songs on his own at first, at one point playing each instrument himself, but it wasn't until he met drummer and co-producer Nikhil Mawkin and bassist Abhinav Khokhar that he found the synergy he was looking for. This led to the release of Akash's first EP, titled Postcards. With its release on 10th January 2015, Postcards introduced Akash to the music community in Delhi as a singer-songwriter and guitar player with a refreshing and honest sound.

event.title: Kumail
event.description:
Kumail Hamid is a young music producer, who has been experimenting with music that can only be classified under the ambiguous label of “electronic music”. His music boldly pushes the level of experimentation of the current “scene” beyond its club friendly confines, exploring the more ethereal regions of sound. Heavily manipulated live recordings coupled with atmospheric synths and meticulously panned rhythm sections form the fundamental characteristics of his music.  

His live act ranges from ambient soundscapes to his more recent, Hip-Hop influenced beats. So far, Kumail has released two well received EP’s and his most recent, very colourful full length album titled ‘Links’.  

Kumail has played for major festivals such as Magnetic Fields, where he shared the line up with Shigeto, DJ Koze, Ratatat, Kutmah and Garden City Movement. He has also had the privilege to play at festivals such as Sunburn (Goa), Bass Camp, Future Theory Festival and Appa Art Festival in Kamshet.

event.description:
Time Wise is an Experimental Jazz Fusion band from Ahmedabad, formed in 2015. We perform Jazz standards with a twist of our own and love to experiment with crisp rhythms and mellow tunes in our original compositions. 

Most of what we play and compose is organically random, and usually, a lot of fun! event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:

Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

His musical skill set includes a variety of genres ranging from Bollywood (contemporary/Timeless classics) to Western Pop, Western Rock and Western Classics.
Being a Professor of Electronics, music has been his utmost passion. The sole purpose and aim of Aviral’s life is to progress as a musician in all aspects and provide mesmerizing and incredible performances to his audiences.
Aviral started singing at the age of three and learned guitar at the age of 13. Ever since, he has been involved in a wide variety of musical activities as well as giving guitar lessons.
He has performed at various college festivals, functions as well as at venues in New Delhi and Mumbai.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!
event.disclaimer: Restaurants are solely responsible for the service; availability and quality of the events including all or any cancellations/ modifications/ complaints.

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.

event.title: Curtain Blue Live and Awesome
event.description:
Curtain Blue is Abhishek Bhatia's solo project.
Vocalist of a Delhi based band, The Circus, Abhishek has also been producing his own electronic music and has finally decided to take it live in the 'Curtain Blue' avatar. Fusing haunting vocal melodies with down tempo and bass sensibilities, he aims to create a textural blend which can uniquely be called his own.
Curtain Blue has performed at a number of venues and festivals in India in the last two years, including the flagship edition of the Magnetic Fields Festival in Rajasthan in 2013, where Berlin based producer Robot Koch saw him perform for the first time. Their initial meeting led to a musical collaboration between the two producers on Koch’s acclaimed ‘TSUKI’ EP, released via MONKEYTOWN Records earlier this year.
He was recently in UK for a 4 City Tour and was very well recieved!

event.title: Bhavya Raj Live and Awesome
event.description:
Bhavya Raj is a young indie pop singer and songwriter based out of the capital city of India, New Delhi. His debut single – 'Spexy Girl ' got released in August 2015 with a music video and is now running on MTV Indies.
He is a self-taught vocalist, drummer, guitarist and producer.
Bhavya does renditions of popular artists like Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Kodaline, Daft Punk, Sam Smith, Frank Sinatra, Louis Armstrong , Michael Jackson, Adele and A R Rahman along with his own originals . Being hugely inspired by Michael Jackson, 'Pop' is one of his strongest genres. So is 'Blues/Hard Rock' owing to the fact that he's currently the vocalist/rhythm guitarist of a three-piece band called 'Leaftone'. 
He has been invited on to Radio One 94.3 numerous times to pay tribute to artists such as Coldplay and the Grammy Nominations 2015.
